info.title: Etamid Collection
info.description:
Generated from the Etamid Postman collection (Etamid_API.postman_collection.json) so it can be browsed and tried from Swagger UI alongside the code-generated Etamid.Api v1 definition.

This is a faithful listing of the collection, not the implemented contract: requests marked [Proposed] in the collection, and endpoints not yet implemented in the backend (wallet, notifications, company deals, support tickets, old deal names such as pay/ship), will return NOT_FOUND (404) when tried against a local backend. For the contract of what is actually implemented, see docs/etamid-openapi.yaml.
